title: Find the hidden file
description:
Amaka leans over your shoulder: real attackers never leave artefacts with obvious names. They make them blend in. Navigate into `/home/intern/evidence/archive/` and locate the manifest The Griot stashed there. Its contents are the flag.

Look at the directory the way an investigator would — if your listing looks suspiciously clean, the listing flag is the problem, not the directory.

welcome: Amaka: the archive is under ~/evidence/archive. The Griot drops dotfiles.
hints: What does an attacker do to a filename so a casual listing skips past it?
Most shells suppress a class of names by default. Find the flag that changes that.
